label: D1 after a reward, while the agent is moderately committed to a1 (mid-episode)
explanation: Fires almost only at D1 (99.9% of mass) when the reward input is 1, and almost only when the agent then picks a1 (upcoming action a1 holds 99.9% of mass; prev_action a1, stay=1; good=S1 holds 84%). It never fires at GO, and essentially never at D2, after unrewarded trials, or before a2 choices. Only observed variables and the model own readouts are used, so no future variables. (D1 & rewarded & choose a1) gets about 100% recall but only 0.10 precision. The firing cases are picked out by the model own state: the D1 policy logit choice in about (4, 7) (all activations fall in the 2.8-8.1 bin) and value about 7.4-7.8. This gives dev F1 0.69 with mass recall 0.96. Firing is concentrated in episode trials 10-69 and absent after about trial 70, and grows with trials since a reversal. False positives have the same observable history as hits, so the unit reads a graded hidden-state direction (a confident, but not saturated, a1/S1-good belief after reward) rather than a discrete history pattern. I did not check what modulates magnitude beyond the quartile coverage, which was flat.
